question: Ron Francis has 1,249 career assists, still second in NHL history behind only Wayne Gretzky. How many times was he named a First- or Second-Team NHL All-Star at season's end?
question_short: Ron Francis ranks second all-time in NHL assists. How many times was he a season-end All-Star?
answer_detail: Francis played 23 seasons and won two Stanley Cups, a Selke and three Lady Byngs, yet in an era packed with star centers he never made a postseason All-Star team. NHL.com called him the most overlooked superstar of his era.
answer_short: Never, despite 1,249 assists; star-packed eras kept him off every postseason All-Star team.
